-- Display saved SQL receipts from the fresh DuckDB 2 validation above.
-- The retained managed connection still has the earlier extension loaded.
WITH saved AS (
  SELECT json FROM read_json_objects('/Users/kevintruong/project/SpurCode/docs/research/artifacts/2026-11-15-rust-macro-qualification-fix/final-99760f547/validation-from-notebook.json')
), count_rows AS (
  SELECT docs.json AS document, item.value AS row_value
  FROM saved docs,
       json_each(docs.json, '$.receipts') receipt,
       json_each(receipt.value, '$.rows') item
  WHERE json_extract_string(receipt.value, '$.name') = 'selected_call_counts'
)
SELECT json_extract_string(row_value, '$.version') AS data_version,
       CAST(json_extract(row_value, '$.calls') AS BIGINT) AS recorded_calls,
       CAST(json_extract(row_value, '$.local_targets') AS BIGINT) AS local_targets,
       json_extract_string(document, '$.duckdb_version') AS validation_runtime,
       json_extract_string(document, '$.extension_sha256') AS corrected_artifact_sha256
FROM count_rows ORDER BY data_version;
